# Northeast Seattle Dispatch

> The Northeast Seattle Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Seattle, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Northeast Seattle](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Northeast Seattle news](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Reader asked](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/asked/): readers' questions answered from the public record
- [Standards](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Laurelhurst](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/laurelhurst/): The peninsula on Union Bay, with Laurelhurst Park and its community center, and the shoreline street ends looking across the water to the Arboretum.
- [Windermere](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/windermere/): The Windermere neighborhood on the Lake Washington shore north of Laurelhurst, along Sand Point Way NE, looking east across the lake.
- [Hawthorne Hills](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/hawthorne-hills/): The hillside above Sand Point Way NE between Bryant and View Ridge, a few blocks up from the Burke-Gilman Trail.
- [Bryant](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/bryant/): Around 40th Avenue NE and NE 55th Street, with Ravenna Park to the west and the Burke-Gilman Trail along its southern edge.
- [Ravenna](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/ravenna/): Ravenna Park's ravine and Cowen Park, the Ravenna Boulevard median, and University Village at the south end.
- [Roosevelt](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/roosevelt/): Roosevelt Station on NE 65th Street, Roosevelt High School and the blocks between I-5 and Ravenna Park.
- [View Ridge](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/view-ridge/): The ridge above Sand Point and Magnuson Park, with View Ridge Playfield and the view east over Lake Washington.
- [Wedgwood](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/wedgwood/): North of NE 75th Street along 35th Avenue NE, with Thornton Creek, the Wedgwood Rock and the 35th Avenue NE business district.
- [Maple Leaf](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/maple-leaf/): The hill around Maple Leaf Reservoir Park and the water tower, between Roosevelt Way NE and Lake City Way NE, south of Northgate.
- [Sand Point](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/sand-point/): Magnuson Park, the Sand Point Way NE corridor and the former naval air station on the Lake Washington shore.
- [University District](https://www.northeastseattledispatch.com/university-district/): The Ave, the U District light rail station, the edge of the University of Washington campus and the Burke-Gilman Trail.
